sections.title: Player-facing description
sections.body: The thing in the reeds is not a normal frog scaled up. It is squat, armored, amber-eyed, and so heavy the mud dimples around it before it moves.

sections.title: Handout text
sections.body: Player-safe note: A bull-sized swamp frog with armored warts, a heavy throat pouch, amber watching eyes, and enough mass to make a muddy bank feel like a sprung trap.
